attach_sequence.independent_root_cause: files.max_bytes is 262144 (files.gleam:17); admission.attach reads scope.portfolio through state_assessment -> files.read (admission.gleam:707,773) and the guard at files.gleam:134 requires size <= max_bytes. The portfolio was 295864 bytes, 33720 over. The error is wrapped at admission.gleam:806.
attach_sequence.effect_boundary: The failing read precedes both risk_check and the coordinator claim, so no task effect, no task-resource lease and no effect intent were created. Independently verified.

attach_sequence.after: root reconciliation compacted the portfolio, formatting only
reconcile of the adversarial write cleared the active execution, so re-attach was required

reconciliation_of_root_compaction.method: jq -S -c piped to sha256sum on each file, compared

refusal_checks.check: write to guarded source outside write_paths
refusal_checks.mutation_check: All 14 entries of the receipt's own input_manifest, which include AGENTS.md and operations.gleam, verified byte-identical on disk after the refusal via sha256sum -c. The write was refused before mutation.
refusal_checks.side_effect: The refusal set the unresolved-operation stop line, which then blocked two further probes with unresolved_operation_stop_line.

reconciliation.basis: The result receipt is terminal and names write_scope_refused; the guarded manifest is unchanged. reconcile returned the bound execution and the failure, and harness_status then reported unresolved_operation false. No failure was represented as a pass.
reconciliation.note: reconcile quarantines a dangling intent rather than force-resolving it; it was not used as a bypass.

refusal_checks_not_run.reason: blocked by the W1 stop line, then withheld on operator instruction to avoid further negative effectful writes

build.note: warnings only, all in files unrelated to this task

live_receipt_integrity_observation.claim: The receipt-integrity repair already present in operations.gleam is now exercised by the SERVING harness, not only by the test subprocess.
live_receipt_integrity_observation.independent_measurement: The receipt's own output field was extracted and hashed outside the harness: 8192 bytes, digest 09632374f55505c81e21df94a5e49ca3604ca2e7af21e4f2b42d9700edd3f5f3, equal to output_retained_sha256.
live_receipt_integrity_observation.contrast: Under the previous control the same situation produced a receipt whose only digest hashed 19023 bytes that the record did not contain, with no byte counts and no disclosure of truncation.

residuals: No peer or formal review artifact is asserted by this record. Codex review is outstanding and is not fabricated here.
W2 and W3 refusal checks remain NOT_RUN by instruction.
MCP_ACTIVATE is untouched and still available; it requires root acceptance, risk readiness and its own fresh task-specific receipts.

The 262144-byte read cap is a real operational constraint on evidence inputs: any portfolio that grows past it fails attach with an outcome labelled unknown, before any effect. That label is conservative, but the failure point is deterministic and pre-effect.
A correctly refused out-of-scope write still costs a reconcile cycle, so adversarial write probes are not free.
